comparison.objective: Intercept and stop a rolling bottle before it falls; candidate adjusts a damper and evaluates carriage stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Fast moving-object interception and gentle arrest versus deliberate small-tool manipulation and iterative mechanism tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle must become still on the worktop without ever crossing an edge; candidate requires two axial carriage stops without bottoming, overload, rebound or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both concern stopping motion, but bottle interception tests reactive catching, not adjustment and validation of a shock absorber.
